title.en: Is it right? Checking a result

concept.hr: Obrnuta operacija provjerava rezultat; procjena hvata promašeno mjesto
concept.en: The inverse operation checks a result; an estimate catches a missed place

summary.hr: Je li zadani rezultat točan? Procijeni iz zaokruženih brojeva, pa provjeri obrnutom operacijom i nađi pogrešan; bilo koja baza.
summary.en: Is the given result right? Estimate from rounded numbers, then check by the inverse operation and find the wrong one; any base.

title.en: 457 · 36 = 4113? An estimate catches a missed place

concept.hr: 500 · 40 = 20000 ima pet znamenaka, 4113 četiri: redovi nisu pomaknuti
concept.en: 500 · 40 = 20000 has five digits, 4113 four: the rows not shifted

title.en: 846 : 3 = 281, remainder 3? The remainder must be less

concept.hr: 281 · 3 + 3 = 846 vrijedi, ali ostatak nije manji od djelitelja
concept.en: 281 · 3 + 3 = 846 holds, but the remainder is not less than the divisor
